properties.title: Nevada Power Company: demand 100% below what its forecast implies, 4 h (EIA-930)
properties.summary: Nevada Power Company (NEVP), which balances southern Nevada, reported 0 MW of demand to EIA for the hour to 07:00 UTC 20 Nov 2026, against its day-ahead forecast of 4,017 MW. Its demand usually runs at 110% of its forecast (the median of the 168 hours before), so about 4,417 MW was expected: 100% below. Demand stayed 25% or more below that for 4 hours in a row, 06:00 UTC 20 Nov 2026 to 10:00 UTC 20 Nov 2026, through the newest hour read, about 17,092 MWh less than expected. A gap like this fits customers losing power (a storm, strikes on the grid, a failure) and also a forecast miss, batteries charging or a reporting error; EIA-930 figures are preliminary and balancing authorities correct them within days. Reported by the balancing authority to EIA; Blackout measures the gap and does not assess the cause. Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (20 Nov 2026).

baseline_ref.window: the balancing authority's own ratio of demand to day-ahead forecast in the 168 hours before the 24-hour window: its median, with the line 25% under it or 1.5 times as far under it as the 1st percentile, whichever is further (BO-IND-16)

properties.summary: Cloudflare Radar's route-leak detection lists 1 provider-customer-provider leak by this network since 2026-11-15T04:33:24Z, all finished; the largest carried 241 prefixes from 32 origin networks and was seen by 67 of Radar's 280 route-collector peers. Path (upstream > leaker > customer): AS41798 > AS61010 (IPNET OOO) > AS205103 (Telegraph42 Management GmbH). Event ID: 670701. A leak can send traffic the long way round or drop it; most are export mistakes (BO-H-4B). Reported by Cloudflare; Blackout does not assess intent.
properties.title: Route leak: AS61010 (IPNET OOO) leaked up to 241 prefixes (Cloudflare Radar)
